_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Your power over your soul is the best power and your authority over it is the best authority.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: The Soul and Holding It to Account
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : كَيْفَ يَسْتَطيعُ صَلاحَ نَفْسِهِ مَنْ لايَقْنَعُ بِالقَليلِ؟!
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, How can one who is not content with little have the ability to reform himself?!
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: The Soul and Holding It to Account
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : كَفى بِالمَرْءِ شُغْلاً بِنَفْسِهِ عَنِ النّاسِ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Being preoccupied with ones soul is enough to keep a person distracted from the people.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: The Soul and Holding It to Account
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : كُنْ أوْثَقَ ما تَكُونُ بِنَفْسِكَ أحْذَرَ (أخْوَفَ) ما تَكُونُ مِنْ خِداعِها
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, At the time when you are most confident in your soul be equally cautious (or fearful) of its deception.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: The Soul and Holding It to Account
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : كُنْ وَصِيَّ نَفْسِكَ وَ افْعَلْ في مالِكَ ما تُحِبُّ أنْ يَفْعَلَهُ فيهِ غَيْرُكَ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Be the guardian of your soul, and do with your possessions that which you would like others to do with it.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: The Soul and Holding It to Account
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : كُنْ مُؤاخِذاً نَفْسَكَ مُغالِباً سُوءَ طَبْعِكَ وَ إيّاكَ أنْ تَحْمِلَ ذُنُوبَكَ عَلى رَبِّكَ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Hold yourself to account and struggle against your evil nature, and beware of blaming your sins on your Lord.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: The Soul and Holding It to Account
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : كُنْ لِنَفْسِكَ مانِعاً رادِعاً وَ لِثَرْوَتِكَ (وَلِنَزْوَتِكَ) عِنْدَ الحَمِيَّةِ (الحَفِيظَةِ) واقِماً قامِعاً
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Be a preventer and a forbidder for yourself [from evil], and a suppressor and a subjugator for your wealth (or outburst) during zeal (or anger).
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: The Soul and Holding It to Account
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : لِلنُّفُوسِ طَبايِعُ سُوء وَ الحِكْمَةُ تَنْهى عَنْها
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, The souls have certain evil natures [and characteristics] and wisdom forbids [one from] them.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: The Soul and Holding It to Account
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : لَيْسَ لأنْفُسِكُمْ ثَمَنٌ إلاّ الجَنَّةُ فَلاتَبيعُوها إلاّ بِها
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, There is no price for your souls except Paradise, so do not sell them for anything but it.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: The Soul and Holding It to Account
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : لَيْسَ مَنْ أساءَ إلى نَفْسِهِ بِذي مَأْمُول
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, There is no expectation [of goodness] from the one who wrongs his own soul.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: The Soul and Holding It to Account
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : لَيْسَ عَلى وَجْهِ الأرْضِ أكْرَمُ عَلَى اللّهِ سُبْحانَهُ مِنَ النَّفْسِ المُطِيعَةِ لأمْرِهِ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, There is none on the face of this earth more honoured in the sight of Allah, the Glorified, than the soul that is obedient to His commands.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: The Soul and Holding It to Account
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : مَنْ تَكَبَّرَ بِنَفْسِهِ قَلَّ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, One who considers himself to be more [important or powerful than others] becomes less.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: The Soul and Holding It to Account
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : مَنْ حَقَّرَ نَفْسَهُ عُظِّمَ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, One who humbles himself is honoured.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: The Soul and Holding It to Account
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : مَنْ أصْلَحَ نَفْسَهُ مَلَكَها
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, One who reforms his soul gains mastery over it.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: The Soul and Holding It to Account
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : مَنْ أهْمَلَ نَفْسَهُ أهْلَكَها
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, One who neglects his soul destroys it.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: The Soul and Holding It to Account
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : مَنْ أكْرَمَ نَفْسَهُ أهانَتْهُ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, One who honours his [carnal] soul is abased by it.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: The Soul and Holding It to Account
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : مَنْ وَثِقَ بِنَفْسِهِ خانَتْهُ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Whoever trusts his [carnal] soul is betrayed by it.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: The Soul and Holding It to Account
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : مَنْ أهْمَلَ نَفْسَهُ خَسِرَ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Whoever neglects his soul incurs loss.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: The Soul and Holding It to Account
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : مَنْ عَرَفَ نَفْسَهُ تَجَرَّدَ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, One who knows himself divests himself [of all worldly desires].
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: The Soul and Holding It to Account
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : مَنْ أطاعَ نَفْسَهُ قَتَلَها
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Whoever obeys his soul kills it.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي
